original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.
Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...).

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.
One reduced copied-total contract for the existing decoder.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Removing copies without a replacement contract for the decoder's copied totals.

actual_scope: For k=2 sharing on the selected paid local word, charge restoration/hosting overhead into ceiling.ceiling and test the card's ≥10% screened-ceiling gate; separate copy-child amortization (centre charge fixed at 64) from a reduced coverage-law centre charge.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue first experiment asks to charge sharing overhead after writing the per-call centre charge and copy children. Ideal zero-overhead share-by-2 already clears 10%, so the useful refinement is which charged obligation is binding: amortizing the eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE children versus reducing the coverage-law centre charge parameter.
bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call (~64% of the raw deficit). Packing-only gains on this word are capped under +0.87%; a centre-charge change is one of the levers with ideal headroom beyond packing.
stop_rule: Stop the construction route for the ≥10% gate if copy-only amortization with fixed centre charge 64 is the only available contract; continue only for contracts that reduce the coverage centre charge to ≤60 (or replace the coverage model).
evidence: PASS_CENTRE_SHARE_OVERHEAD_SCREEN ideal_gate=PASS copy_only_gate=FAIL max_centre_for_10pct=60 rank1_overhead_clears_all_idle=True controls=8 no_new_kappa

open_questions.why_it_matters: The screen shows copy amortization alone cannot meet the card's ≥10% gate; only a reduced centre charge (or replacement coverage model) can.
